projects.title: Seen From Afar
projects.description:
We were asked to produce a TV commercial that would portray Kosova Petrol as the leading petrol company in the country.

Priding themselves with the quality of their petrol, we used an analogy used in Albanian language, which, when describing something so obvious is said that it can be seen from an airplane.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XlFtsuhDW2E

So, we used a small aircraft that lands at the petrol station to refuel, saying that the quality is seen from afar. The TV advert became a novelty, since a plane has been used in this manner for the first time.
